verdict.rationale: Undermind's only standing background capability is paper alerts ("get notified whenever relevant papers are published"). Its deep-research agent runs on its own once started, planning searches and following citations until results run dry. Programmatic API and MCP access let users wire it into their own workflows, but there is no evidence of user-defined, scheduled or triggered automations, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: user-configurable recurring/triggered automations, docs on background execution and alert setup, independent hands-on corroboration.
